#!/usr/bin/env bash
# usage: step.sh NAME -- cmd...   (records evidence under evidence/NAME)
set -u
name="$1"; shift; [ "$1" = "--" ] && shift
d=/datapool/mantle-store/cold-inputs-20261030/evidence/$name
mkdir -p "$d"
printf '%q ' "$@" > "$d/command.txt"; echo >> "$d/command.txt"
date -u +%FT%TZ > "$d/started_at"
s=$(date +%s.%N)
"$@" > "$d/stdout.log" 2> "$d/stderr.log"
rc=$?
e=$(date +%s.%N)
echo $rc > "$d/exit_code"
python3 -c "print(round($e-$s,2))" > "$d/wall_seconds"
date -u +%FT%TZ > "$d/finished_at"
exit $rc
